facts.fact: The electoral roll for the 19 July 2026 presidential election was compiled automatically from civil registry (DGRN) data under the EU-funded PRESE, and the provisional roll holds 146,510 voters, per the CEN president.
The provisional roll is open for public consultation from 1 to 8 August 2026 at district, regional and diaspora electoral commissions and online on the CEN website, per the CEN president.
The roll for the 19 July 2026 presidential election was compiled automatically from data of the civil registry directorate (DGRN) for the first time.
